spec_quote: A URL containing "/my-profile" whose text has "Applied on <M/D/YYYY>" (one or two digit month and day, two or four digit year; case-insensitive) → "done".

spec_quote: Without "Applied on <date>" the My Profile page is not "done". (Ambiguous: the spec only rules out "done" and does not name the value returned instead, so any non-"done" string satisfies it.)

name: job id as a whole number in 'Careers 8491' plus Applied on → True
spec_quote: True only when the text has "Applied on <date>" (as above) AND either the job id appears as a whole number (not inside a longer number: "8491" is in "Careers 8491" but not in "84910") or the title appears (case-insensitive).
